title: pool_acquire: the 'recovery_slot' name is misleading — this is actually the new-fd-open path
description: The pool_acquire() uses a variable named 'recovery_slot' and the path is described as 'recovery'. But the only way a slot becomes empty (fd==-1) is after pool_release fails to re-open the fd. This is the normal operation slot startup path (all slots start empty), not an error recovery path. The name 'recovery_slot' implies the slot was previously in an error state, which misleads contributors into thinking this path is exceptional. Rename to 'empty_slot' and the comment to 'first empty slot (fd not yet opened)' to accurately describe what happens.
